title: Core: location sources, freshness, and response estimates
audience: Department administrators and dispatchers reviewing the fictional training department.
summary: Review stored department and station locations, map filters, marker context, location age and response estimates in actual Core screens.
prerequisites: Use the isolated fictional Firehouse51 training department and an already authorized Core administrator session.
Keep original calls, shared settings, Engine51 station/crew and member qualifications unchanged. This lesson reads the retained states.
Understand that native device tracking, provider delivery and wider saved reference-data workflows require separate evidence.

scenes.title: Read the map as evidence
scenes.capture_intent: Show the ordered full legible real Core screenshot states in this scene. Keep history/readonly/conditional limits explicit; do not introduce unseen operations.
scenes.narration: On Mapping, read the warehouse call label and open description before interpreting the marker. That popup identifies a fictional incident; it does not establish where a person or apparatus is now. This walkthrough reviews Core administration and recorded training data. Device permissions and field tracking need their own application checks. Keep that distinction visible when using location information for fire and EMS, community response, or industrial standby.

The displayed distance and time do not prove physical presence, arrival, or an active navigation route.

scenes.capture_intent: Show the ordered full legible real Core screenshot states in this scene. Keep history/readonly/conditional limits explicit; do not introduce unseen operations.
required_labels: TTL In Minutes for Personnel Locations
TTL In Minutes for Unit Locations

scenes.narration: In Mapping and BigBoard Settings, review personnel and unit controls separately. TTL In Minutes for Personnel Locations and TTL In Minutes for Unit Locations both show zero in these views. Zero disables ping expiry; the help text’s sixty-minute example is not a saved sixty. A location-bearing status can remain a fallback after a ping expires. The separate no-location-status checkboxes affect replacement behavior. Check the policy and position source before promising that a marker will disappear.

scenes.title: Review dispatch age and response limits in seconds
scenes.capture_intent: Show the ordered full legible real Core screenshot states in this scene. Keep history/readonly/conditional limits explicit; do not introduce unseen operations.
scenes.narration: In dispatch settings, Closest Unit Response Tuning has separate age controls. Maximum unit location age and Maximum personnel location age are in seconds; both recorded values are eighteen hundred. They differ from map TTL measured in minutes. Include stale locations is unchecked. Maximum response radius is zero, meaning no configured maximum radius. These controls influence candidate evaluation. They do not certify a fresh fix, prove service-area coverage, or change a resource position because the map refreshed.
scenes.practice: Compare units and meaning: map TTL minutes versus dispatch maximum-age seconds. Read the captured values and leave shared dispatch policy unchanged.

sector_examples.scenario: An ambulance crew is selected near a training hospital.
sector_examples.practice: Compare station-origin versus GPS categories, status time and dispatch age before using ETA; add a hospital POI only in a separately captured saved workflow.

sector_examples.scenario: A mobile crisis team coordinates a shared community support vehicle.
sector_examples.practice: Use the appropriate member/location permissions, check age/source, and avoid treating an old phone point or a hidden category as the vehicle’s actual availability.

sector_examples.scenario: A search team stages at a trailhead.
sector_examples.practice: Distinguish fixed staging coordinates, station origin, simulated/stale team fixes and actual device permissions. Planned search layers remain a separate saved geometry workflow.

sector_examples.scenario: A patrol unit starts a campus round.
sector_examples.practice: Read category filters and position source before recommending a response. Saved patrol stops/Unit assignment and route execution require separate actual screens, not an ETA popup.

sector_examples.scenario: A mutual-aid engine moves between bases.
sector_examples.practice: Confirm the intended station assignment and source age before using a station fallback. Review weather zones as center/radius and actual policy; do not infer field connectivity or recipient delivery.

sector_examples.scenario: An industrial team investigates a fictional warehouse alarm.
sector_examples.practice: Separate the warehouse incident point/icon from vehicle location and status. Treat floor plans/custom overlays as reference material pending saved alignment and currency review.

recording_limits: This is a bounded separate Core source freeze, not replacement approval for canonical legacy07. All original12 gap groups are preserved from the prospective checkpoint; wider workflows remain explicitly incomplete.

All screenshot states are historical fictional training evidence from different recorded instants, not one continuous live incident or present operational status. In particular the displayed Released state is historical; no present Engine51 state is asserted.

Department/station coordinates are read-only existing fictional values. No edit/Save/geocoding/what3words lookup, real GPS permission, physical movement, provider delivery or dispatch receipt is claimed.

The location-less-status policy and positive TTL expiry are explained from source only; no new policy change, elapsed-time experiment or guaranteed marker disappearance is demonstrated. Numeric source-fix age/expiry comparison remains separate work.

No routed driving provider result, route execution, POI creation, layer saving, weather-zone save/delivery, floor-plan/custom/indoor upload/alignment, native location/background success or actual arrival is demonstrated.

Icons are read from actual stored preview/legend/incident context. No new upload, concurrency fix or global marker consistency claim is made. All overlapping co-located controls on marker005 are excluded.

No audio, captions, cue times, rendered frames, playback observations or completed video are provided by this freeze. All subsequent exact-word, timing, image-legibility, frame and browser gates still apply.
